howToRead: EVIDENCE: 16 emulator screenshots, 360 dp wide x font scale 1.15, 1080x2424 px (3 px = 1 dp), DEV build 1f909660 = UI wave 1, owner test account. Folder: <scratchpad>/ : emu_shots/t1_01..t1_16, emu_tour1.json (key inv = text + bounds), vis_crops/ (my magnified crops). t1_04 and t1_05 are BYTE-IDENTICAL (md5 fef95f1630e624d641f1b3dc9a2c5c7b, both the task detail), so there are 15 distinct screens.

All positions are device px 'x0-x1, y0-y1' as in the inv list. Hex colours are the most frequent pixel of the glyph or shape; contrast ratios are computed on white; cap height in dp = px/3. Facts are measured; 'reading' lines are my interpretation.

RULES THE FIXES MUST RESPECT: AGENTS.md 3.6 (white reading surfaces, green primary with white label, orange only for what waits, text >= 12 px at ordinary size, one card look, FactArt is the one fact-icon system, no eyebrow copy), owner decisions U01-U19 (docs/implementation/product-v1-closure-20260926/finalization-20260927/OWNER_DECISIONS_20261002_ALL75.md, section Appearance), B22 (no new Reanimated layout/entering/exiting animation, avoid animated SVG draws), no new npm dependency, no server change. LOCKED, never edit: src/ui/entry/**, src/ui/referenceEntry/**, EntryWelcome, mascot, HOME signature.

SOURCES OF TRUTH: tokens src/ui/system/tokens.ts and src/theme/tokens.ts (type scale), icon rulebook docs/implementation/design-system/ICON_SYSTEM.md, plan docs/implementation/ui-ux-pass-20261002/UIUX_PLAN_20261002.json (waves W1-W12, item numbers like 2.1 are used below) and UIUX_AUDITS_20261002.json (ids HP-, Z, MZ-, DG-F, ICO-, MO-M = 'known'). The working tree holds other agents' uncommitted edits (ScreenChrome, ScreenHeader, MarketplacePresentation, profil ...): re-read a file before editing it; the screenshots show build 1f909660, not the tree. File names given in topTenNextWave are likely locations found by name, not verified line by line.
SEVERITY: S1 hurts legibility or identity, S2 inconsistent or weak, S3 polish. 'known' = already in the audits/plan (the build has not reached it yet); 'new' = not in the plan.

patterns: Colour is told per screen, not per meaning: the same fact (term, flexible, unconfirmed, waits, unread, title) has two to four looks across screens.
Two icon dialects share lists: flat 20-dp marks and glossy 26-32 dp stickers, split by a 24/26 dp threshold; paper stickers look washed, solid ones heavy.
Bold is the default weight and the middle of the ramp (16 to 12 dp cap) is compressed, so hierarchy leans on colour.
Same object, different surface: bordered card (Home), unboxed row (Dogovori), shadowed card (workspace), bordered tile (Profil).
Wraps and truncation ignore pairs (number+unit, route, date) and use at least three ellipsis idioms.
Edges: floating bar, chrome rings, hairlines and rows use 16, 20 and 24 dp insets and 2-8 dp text-start steps.
Wave-1 rules (quiet calendar, flat marks, token colours) reached TaskFace and the 16-24 dp card rows only; Home, Dogovori, Profil, Inbox and the application card still use the old looks.
keepAsIs: Flat 20-dp one-tone marks on card rows and detail facts (pin, calendar, users, money, tag, remote): crisp and nameable (t1_05, t1_10, t1_12).
Detail type ramp: hero green 700 > money 700 > h2 > body (t1_05, t1_12), and the sticky full-width green primary with white label (6.3:1).
White reading surfaces with 1-px #DEDEDE r24 list cards and 20-dp gutters; sheet handle and r28 sheet.
Wordmark-centred root chrome and the 48-dp circle positions; compact header title collapse on scroll.
Segmented tabs with a green underline and count pill; the orange pill for 'Čeka te 4' is the right use of orange.
Map palette (near-white ground, blue water, green parks) and brand pin discs (U07); credits remain visible (legal).
Pale hairlines between disclosure/inbox rows and the consistent 60-px left gutter.
direction: One calm icon family: flat one-tone marks up to 24 dp everywhere (UI green #076E4E), stickers only as art at 48 dp and up; the tab bar uses quiet flat marks (U01, U18).
A real ramp: door/hero 22-26 800, card title 17-20 700, body 16 500, meta/status 13 600; price right-aligned tabular in the one green; status chip first.
Colour = meaning: green do/confirmed/money, muted for unknown/flexible/unconfirmed/history, orange only for dot/badge/star, one brown for words.
Surfaces: white; hairline r24 cards for list items, unboxed rows with hairlines for details, shadow only for what floats (tab bar, map controls, sheets) (U15).
Home as a poster: two bounded photo doors (U02) and one bounded 'Čeka te' group with an orange count pill.
Chrome with weight: bold 24 glyphs in #CDCDCD rings with captions for non-universal controls, visible 'Poruke' tab, header fade (U11).
Brand character from entry photography and the handshake mark, state-aware pins, tinted initials avatars instead of identical gray discs.
Motion later and only transform/opacity (B22): selection capsule, list-swap fade, arrival fade; not judgeable from stills.
notVerified: Motion, press and disabled states, haptics, skeleton/loading, scroll edge behaviour and the edge fade at other scroll offsets: a still image cannot show them.
Real HONOR rendering: the emulator is 3.0 px/dp software-GL; the phone is ~3.5 px/dp, so 20-dp marks are 60 px here and ~70 px there; colour profile and daylight legibility unchecked.
Whether the 'Is' tab and the 4th tab 'Završene' are reachable by scrolling, and whether the two-dot truncation is a font-glyph or a code path (cause unverified).
Screens not in the set (filters, Pregled applications, chat, composer, empty/error states, AI flow), dark mode, text scale 1.3 and 320 dp stacking.
Screen-reader labels and focus order; WCAG results above are computed on white from sampled pixels, not from the token source.
t1_04 is identical to t1_05, so the Zadaci list-full state was not captured.
The checkout has uncommitted edits by other agents: the build 1f909660 may differ from the current tree; re-read files before editing.
